policy.status: post-hoc exploratory sensitivity requested after inspecting revised-label correspondence
policy.object_rule: one-to-one greedy; descending overlap then stable label IDs; centroid view uses existing benchmark descending IoU, distance, stable IDs within 2 m
policy.region_rule: union tree and tree_group per rater within fixed sites; remove internal boundaries; preserve polygon holes; no disagreement-derived exclusion masks
policy.tolerant_area_rule: A-support = area(A intersect buffer(B,d))/area(A), B-support = area(B intersect buffer(A,d))/area(B); harmonic mean. Buffers intersect site domain. At d=0 this equals canopy Dice.
policy.many_to_many_rule: region links require positive intersection covering at least 50% of the smaller polygon; linked-object fractions are not one-to-one detection F1. Also report each polygon's coverage by the other rater's entire region union.
policy.uncertainty_rule: exclude uncertain and not_tree classes from vegetation views; retain all confirmed trees; never create masks from TW uncertain regions

sources.basis: NEON benchmark distinguishes detection and delineation, examines IoU sensitivity and uses 0.4. Threshold inclusivity and pooled counts here retain the project implementation; this is not a replication of that benchmark.
Existing 2 m centroid tolerance is reused as an exploratory rater-location view; the original rater protocol is not replaced.

policy.interpretation: Report all settings; do not select a favorable threshold as evidence of passing. Larger tolerances allow more boundary disagreement. These revised labels are not independent blind annotations. No automatic freeze or model scoring changes.
